thread:
maria: FYI I found several orphaned Vault policies that still reference an old partner IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/partner-ingest. They grant KMS decrypt via a grant id and there's also wrapped ciphertext in transit/wrap/backup.

maria: paths I pulled: `kv-v2/partners/ingest/creds`, `policy: partner-ingest-access`, `transit/wrap/backup/2023-07` — pasting the policy snippet below:
maria: ```
path "kv-v2/partners/ingest/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
  allowed_arns = ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/partner-ingest"]
}
```

devon: can you drop the list of grant ids and which KMS keys are involved? we should revoke first before touching ciphertext. @sam fyi.

maria: grant ids: `g-0a1b2c3d4e`, `g-9f8e7d6c5b` — CMKs: `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc` and `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/dddd-eeee-ffff`. I also saw wrapped blobs in s3 bucket `partner-backups-prod` under `2023/07/`

sam: ok plan suggestion: 1) revoke KMS grants 2) apply a short-lived deny override to the Vault policies (prevent new decrypt ops) 3) rewrap ciphertext with new CMK + rotate wrapped keys 4) rotate any KV secrets and reissue creds if needed 5) export audit logs for partner arn and keep in secure retention.

jess: +1. We should also lock RBAC for the Vault mount so only vault-admins can modify policies during this op. add a canary rollback step in case services break.

devon: starting revoke now: `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id g-0a1b2c3d4e --key-id aaaa-bbbb-cccc` (running). I will also add a vault policy override: `vault write sys/policy/partner-ingest-access deny = true` (will tag).

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4821: "orphaned-vault-policy-arn-cleanup" assigned to devon, sam. ETA 3h.

devon: revoke complete for g-0a1b2c3d4e, retire for g-9f8e7d6c5b queued. I set policy override to read-only and added audit annotation: `incident:1746053210`.

maria: thanks. sam, rewrap job should use vault transit rewrap with new CMK via KMS envelope. Example command we plan to run: `vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=<blob> rewrap_to_key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/NEW-KEY-ID` — ensure HSM-backed CMK if required.

sam: I'll run a small batch first (10 blobs) to validate. then do full rewrap with dedupe to avoid double-encrypt. Also will run `vault kv metadata get kv-v2/partners/ingest` to identify versions to rotate.

devon: quick note on audit logging: enable full audit-forwarding for the duration to sec-archive and increase retention to 90 days. I pushed logs export job: `audit-exporter --query "principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012" --out s3://sec-team-exports/1746053210/`

maria: legal hold? partner was decommed last year but legal wants 90 days. jess can you confirm retention?

jess: confirmed, sec/legal asked for 90 days of raw audit and a sanitized copy for partner compliance. add that to INFRA-4821.

sam: batch rewrap done for 10 blobs, validated decryption with new CMK and Vault transit. No service regressions on canary. Proceeding with full rewrap (estimate 40m).

devon: retired last grant g-9f8e7d6c5b. KMS grants removed. I also removed the allowed_arns entry from the policy and pushed a deny override for 24h.

maria: I'll rotate KV secrets next. Running `vault kv put kv-v2/partners/ingest/creds username=newuser password=<redacted>` and flagging old versions deprecated.

devon: I updated RBAC on the Vault mount: only `vault-admins` + `sec-ops` can write policies now. Added a short-lived rolebinding change in k8s: `kubectl patch clusterrolebinding vault-policy-admin --patch '{...}'` (locked down).

jess: status check — INFRA-4821 now has: revoked grants, rewrapped blobs, rotated KV secrets, RBAC lockdown, audit export pushed. Any missing items?

sam: add follow-ups: 1) run secret-usage scan to ensure no services still reference old creds, 2) sweep partner S3 for leftover ciphertext, 3) close legal retention ticket after 90d. I'll open follow-up task SEC-9012 for secret-usage scan.

maria: results of audit export: found 7 decrypt ops in the last 18 months tied to that arn, all pre-2024. Exported CSV to s3 and shared with legal.

devon: everything green here. I will remove the deny override in 24h if no issues and then delete the stale policy.

jess: great job. please paste final post-op summary in the ticket and mark thread resolved. :thumbsup:

maria: summary pasted to INFRA-4821 and SEC-9012. Closing thread in 1h unless anyone objects.

sam: no objections. closing.
